title: Ward 142 enriched illustrative dataset (v1)
geography: All coordinates are deterministic offsets inside the modelled Ward 142 demonstration area (service points recovered from the original seed). No device, IP or personal location is used.
timeAnchor: Event timestamps are relative to the day the owner SQL is executed (Asia/Kolkata). Supabase timestamptz values are stored in UTC.
